name: ecc
description: Harness-native ECC plugin for engineering teams - 68 agents, 293 skills, 94 legacy command shims, reusable hooks, rules, MCP conventions, and operator workflows for Claude Code plus adjacent agent harnesses

hooks_enabled.title: Enable ECC hooks
hooks_enabled.description: Run ECC's local lifecycle, quality, and safety automation. Disable this to keep skills and commands without local hook automation.

hook_profile.title: ECC hook profile
hook_profile.description: Choose minimal, standard, or strict. Invalid values safely fall back to standard.

disabled_hooks.title: Disabled ECC hooks
disabled_hooks.description: Comma-separated hook ids to skip. Defaults to the hooks that block or rewrite routine tool calls (GateGuard edit gate, config protection, auto-tmux dev servers). Clear it to run every hook in the selected profile.

gateguard_routine_bash_disabled.title: Skip GateGuard routine shell gate
gateguard_routine_bash_disabled.description: Skip GateGuard's first-command gate for routine Bash/PowerShell. Destructive commands (rm -rf, git push --force, git reset --hard...) are still gated.
